seeds.task: check exists → read → write backup

available_tools.name: exists
available_tools.description: Check whether a single file or directory exists at the given path. Returns is_present=true if the path exists, false otherwise. Does NOT read content, count lines, validate syntax, or perform any operation on the file.

available_tools.name: list_directory
available_tools.description: List the immediate children of a directory (files and subdirectories). Set recursive=true to include all nested entries. Returns names only — does NOT read file content, count files, search for patterns, filter by extension, or compute any metrics.

available_tools.name: read_file
available_tools.description: Read the full raw text content of a file and return it as a string. Use this when you need the content of a file to pass to a subsequent step. Does NOT count lines, search for patterns, parse structure, compute checksums, validate syntax, or process the content in any way.

available_tools.name: create_file
available_tools.description: Write content to a file, creating it if it does not exist and overwriting it if it does. Parent directories are created automatically. Does NOT append — use append_to_file for that. Does NOT execute the file or validate its content.

available_tools.name: append_to_file
available_tools.description: Append a string to the end of an existing file without overwriting it. Does NOT create the file if it does not exist — use create_file for that.

available_tools.name: delete_file
available_tools.description: Delete a single file at the given path. Returns deleted=false (not an error) if the file does not exist. Does NOT delete directories — use remove_directory for that.

available_tools.name: copy_file
available_tools.description: Copy a single file from source_path to destination_path, preserving content and metadata. Does NOT copy directories. Does NOT move or rename — use move_file for that.

available_tools.name: move_file
available_tools.description: Move or rename a single file from source_path to destination_path. Does NOT copy directories. Does NOT copy — use copy_file to keep the original.

available_tools.name: make_directory
available_tools.description: Create a directory at the given path, including any missing parent directories. Does NOT create files inside the directory. Does NOT run scripts, initialise projects, copy files, or execute any commands. Does NOT remove directories — use remove_directory for that.

available_tools.name: remove_directory
available_tools.description: Remove a directory at the given path. Set recursive=true to remove non-empty directories including all contents. Does NOT remove individual files — use delete_file for that.

available_tools.name: run_shell_command
available_tools.description: Execute an arbitrary shell command and capture stdout, stderr, and return_code. Use this ONLY when no other catalog tool can fulfil the task — for example: counting lines (wc), searching content (grep), compressing files (tar/zip), checking system state (df, ps, git), running scripts or compilers, or any operation that requires a shell. Do NOT use this when exists, read_file, list_directory, create_file, copy_file, move_file, delete_file, make_directory, or remove_directory fits.
